# Response

> > Response is a 60-year mental health support and housing charity serving Oxfordshire, Berkshire, and Buckinghamshire with integrated services for adults and young people (11-25).

Response provides comprehensive mental health services and supported housing across three counties, with specialized support for young people, adults with dual diagnosis, and neurodiversity inclusion. The organization uses the RReM360 recovery model and emphasizes co-production with service users.

## Key Topics

- Mental health support
- Supported housing
- Young people (11-25)
- Crisis support
- CAMHS outreach
- Social prescribing
- Housing support
- Dual diagnosis
- Neurodiversity
- Community partnerships
- Oxfordshire Mental Health Partnership
- Recovery model
- Wellbeing hubs
- Co-production
- Experts by Experience

## Core Services

- [Mental Health Support & Housing Charity | Response](https://www.response.org.uk): Response homepage: mental health support and housing charity across Oxfordshire, Berkshire, Buckinghamshire.
- [About Response: Mental Health & Housing Charity](https://www.response.org.uk/about-us): About Response: 60-year history providing mental health support and safe housing.
- [Adult Mental Health Services & Housing Support](https://www.response.org.uk/adults): Adult mental health services overview: supported housing, recovery, dual diagnosis.
- [Mental Health Support & Housing for Young People (11-25)](https://www.response.org.uk/children-and-young-people): Young people's mental health services (11-25): CAMHS outreach, social prescribing.
- [Supported Housing for Adults with Mental Health Needs](https://www.response.org.uk/adults/supported-housing): Supported housing services for adults with 24-hour mental health support.
- [Mental Health & Housing Support for Adults](https://www.response.org.uk/adults/how-we-support-people): How Response supports adults using RReM360 recovery model and Care Certificate.

## Support for Young People

- [Support for Young People Facing Mental Health Challenges](https://www.response.org.uk/children-and-young-people/im-a-young-person): Mental health support for young people: toolkits, anxiety, depression resources.
- [General Mental Health Advice for Young People](https://www.response.org.uk/children-and-young-people/im-a-young-person/general-advice): General mental health advice and self-help resources for ages 5-25.
- [Support for Parents & Carers of Young People](https://www.response.org.uk/children-and-young-people/im-a-parentcarer): Guidance for parents/carers of young people (5-25) with mental health challenges.
- [Support for Youth Service Workers Supporting Young People](https://www.response.org.uk/children-and-young-people/i-work-within-youth-services): Resources for youth workers supporting young people's mental health and wellbeing.
- [How We Support Youth Services Supporting Young People](https://www.response.org.uk/children-and-young-people/i-work-within-youth-services/how-we-can-help): CAMHS outreach and social prescribing support for youth services.

## Crisis Support & Emergency Help

- [Urgent Help Available 24/7 | Crisis Support Services](https://www.response.org.uk/adults/need-urgent-help): 24/7 crisis support resources: Samaritans, Shout, Safe Haven, NHS helplines.

## Partnerships & Community

- [Oxfordshire Mental Health Partnership (OMHP) Support](https://www.response.org.uk/adults/oxfordshire-mental-health-partners-omhp): OMHP partnership information: coordinated mental health care across Oxfordshire.
- [Engagement and Participation](https://www.response.org.uk/adults/engagement-and-participation): Co-production approach with Experts by Experience and Advisory Board.

- [Get Involved: Support Mental Health & Housing Services](https://www.response.org.uk/get-involved): Get involved hub: volunteering, donations, fundraising, and advocacy opportunities.

- [Contact Response: Mental Health & Housing Support](https://www.response.org.uk/contact): Contact information for Response at AG Palmer House, Oxford.

## Careers & Workplace

- [Join Our Team: Careers in Mental Health & Housing](https://www.response.org.uk/join-our-team): Careers page with job opportunities and employee benefits at Response.
- [Neurodiversity at Response](https://www.response.org.uk/join-our-team/neurodiversity): Neurodiversity support and workplace inclusion for autistic, ADHD, dyslexic staff.
